description: A lightweight 'finger' program; print user information.

option.name: --lookup
tip: attempt to canonicalize hostnames via DNS

option.name: -b
tip: omit the user's home directory and shell in long format

option.name: -f
tip: omit the line of column headings in short format

option.name: -h
tip: omit the user's project file in long format

option.name: -i
tip: omit the user's full name and remote host in short format

option.name: -l
tip: produce long format output for the specified USERs

option.name: -p
tip: omit the user's plan file in long format

option.name: -q
tip: omit the user's full name, remote host and idle time in short format

option.name: -s
tip: do short format output, this is the default

option.name: -w
tip: omit the user's full name in short format
